short_description: CPH & Associates is one of the most popular malpractice insurance providers for therapists, counselors, and social workers, offering affordable professional liability coverage with easy online enro...
long_description: CPH & Associates has been providing professional liability insurance to mental health professionals for over 40 years. They specialize in coverage for counselors, therapists, social workers, psychologists, and other behavioral health providers. Policies start at approximately $129/year for students and scale based on coverage limits and profession. Standard coverage options include $1M/$3M and $2M/$4M limits. CPH offers occurrence-based policies (which cover incidents that occur during the policy period regardless of when claims are filed) as well as claims-made options. Coverage includes defense costs outside the limit, license protection, and coverage for telehealth services. The application process is entirely online with instant coverage available. CPH is known for excellent customer service and has an A-rated carrier backing their policies. They also offer free risk management resources and CE courses to policyholders.

faqs.q: What's the difference between occurrence and claims-made policies?
faqs.a: Occurrence policies cover incidents that happen during the policy period regardless of when claims are filed. Claims-made only covers claims filed while the policy is active. CPH offers both.
